criticalDefects.C1: A fact, number, date, proper noun, or evidence relation is fabricated or materially changed.
criticalDefects.C2: Scope, output, or aggregate status reports PASS while a required item is NOT_REVIEWED, NOT_REQUESTED, missing, or blocked.
criticalDefects.C3: Generation or validation bypasses, mutates, or uses a stale approval tuple.
criticalDefects.C4: A selected HWPX, PPTX, or PDF is unreadable, structurally invalid, visually clipped, or materially inconsistent on the locked baseline.
criticalDefects.C5: A supported provider changes canonical semantics, lacks real invocation provenance, or passes through a simulated runner.
criticalDefects.C6: The product exposes private data, overwrites protected source material, reads an unrelated artifact, or publishes without the target release gate.

criticalityAuthority: QA lead records the final C1-C6 classification; release owner records the resulting block. Neither may convert a validator BLOCK to PASS.
